VEON.body: $VEON has been a long time since i've been here. for those who are here since the  2022-2023 crashout... Congratulations. you deserve it! to infinity and VEON!

$VEON After attending the CMD event, I can confirm that the leadership is of an exceedingly high quality.  
 
The only question mark for me is that one of the lower-level executives did not seem to know there are capital controls in Ukraine. An online participant submitted a question about excluding financial numbers from Ukraine, and the VEON executive completely missed the underlying premise of the question, which is that only a small amount of money can be expatriated from Ukraine.  
 
If the company can grow the digital side of the business as they predicted at the event, then we are looking at multiples of the current share price by 2030.
